PROS: Easy to install. It covers the whole front and sides. I purchased this design because of the zippered front. The cover I had for years required I remove the whole thing before washing. More often than not, the cover remained off and was shoved around to the furthest corner of the room. This washing machine cover is a bit bigger than my machine. It has velcro strips on the top to hold it in place and zippered sides easy to reattach after use.
The CONS: My washroom area faces the west. The afternoon sun pours in to the area. Ive noticed the discoloration happening very quickly. The first photo shows the shade difference. The leaves were green but now its red. The fabric is very thin as well. It does not propel water well, either. Im not too confident in the durability of the fabric or how long it will hold up before getting brittle from uv exposure which is another reason why I bought it.
Conclusion: Its doing the job for the most part. My decision to purchase it again would strongly depend on how long it stands up through time. So there will be a part 2 atleast a year from now. Received order in 12/2021.
